## Day by day

### Day 1 – Thu 2027-04-01: Porto City Centre
Weather: overcast, 23‑13 °C – no rain. Walk: – km
- **19:05 Arrive in Porto** – Flight arrival (see Getting there and back).  
- **21:30 MUU Steakhouse** – High‑budget steak dinner.  
  *Budget tier*: high.  
  [source](https://www.muusteakhouse.com)

### Day 2 – Fri 2027-04-02: Porto City Centre
Weather: overcast, 20.6‑9.4 °C – no rain. Walk: 1.4 km
- **10:00 São Bento Train Station** – The main hall is lined with ~20 000 blue‑and‑white azulejo panels depicting Portuguese history. Free entry.  
  Hours: open daily (main hall all day).  
  ticket €0 (free).  
  [source](https://porto.travel/porto-train-station-sao-bento)
- **12:30 O Comercial** – Refined Portuguese dishes with a modern twist.  
  *Budget tier*: high.  
  [source](https://ocomercial.com)
- **14:00 Palácio da Bolsa** – 19th‑century neoclassical stock‑exchange building, famous for its lavish Arab Room and a wine‑tasting hall.  
  Hours: 09:00‑18:30 daily.  
  ticket €12.  
  [source](https://palaciodabolsa.com/)
- **18:00 Galeria de Paris Restaurante Bar** – Casual bar for a relaxed dinner.  
  *Budget tier*: mid.  
  [source](https://www.facebook.com/restaurantegaleriadeparis)

### Day 3 – Sat 2027-04-03: Porto City Centre
Weather: overcast, 22.2‑10.7 °C – no rain. Walk: 3.9 km
- **10:00 Church of São Francisco** – Gothic church with an opulent Baroque interior richly gilded; interior features intricate azulejo tiles.  
  Ticket info: see the website.  
  [source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Church_of_S%C3%A3o_Francisco_(Porto))
- **12:30 Padaria Cristo Rei** – Bakery good for a pastel de nata and coffee.  
  *Budget tier*: low.  
  [source](https://www.cristorei.com.pt)
- **14:00 Museu do Vinho do Porto** – Interactive exhibits on the history of port wine inside an 18th‑century warehouse on the Douro.  
  Hours: 10:00‑17:30 Tue‑Sun.  
  ticket €4.  
  [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/210571326)
- **19:30 Euskalduna Studio** – High‑budget tasting‑menu dinner.  
  *Budget tier*: high.  
  [source](http://www.euskaldunastudio.pt)

### Day 4 – Sun 2027-04-04: Porto City Centre
Weather: overcast, 23‑11.8 °C – no rain. Walk: 5.0 km
- **10:00 Clérigos Tower** – 76 m Baroque tower offering panoramic city views after climbing 226 steps.  
  Hours: 09:00‑19:00 daily.  
  ticket €5.  
  [source](https://www.torredosclerigos.pt/)
- **12:30 Casa Da Foz** – Mid‑tier Italian lunch; reservation recommended.  
  *Budget tier*: mid.  
  [source](https://www.casadafoz.pt)

### Day 5 – Mon 2027-04-05: Porto City Centre
Weather: overcast, 22.9‑10.6 °C – no rain. Walk: 1.2 km
- **10:00 Fundação de Serralves** – Contemporary art museum and park designed by Álvaro Siza; rotating exhibitions inside a modernist villa.  
  Hours: not listed.  
  ticket €8.5.  
  [source](http://www.serralves.pt/en/)
- **13:00 Varanda Da Barra** – Riverside lunch with Portuguese dishes.  
  *Budget tier*: mid.  
  [source](#)

Weather: light rain, 28.3‑15.3 °C – rain. Walk: 1.3 km
- **10:00 Casa da Música** – Modern concert hall by Rem Koolhaas; guided tours showcase avant‑garde architecture.

## Food to try
- **Caldo verde** – The Minho speciality, caldo verde, is a soup made from kale, potatoes and spiced smoked sausage. – [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Portugal#Eat)
- **Bacalhau à Brás** – Bacalhau, the revered salt cod, is prepared in many ways, notably as Bacalhau à Brás with shredded cod, onions and potatoes. – [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Portugal#Eat)
- **Sardinhas assadas** – Grilled sardines, a beloved fish dish that features heavily in Portuguese cuisine, especially in summer. – [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Portugal#Eat)
- **Pastel de nata** – Portuguese egg‑tart pastry dusted with cinnamon. – [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q1421401)
- **Francesinha** – Hearty Portuguese sandwich stacked with cured meats, covered in melted cheese and a rich tomato‑beer sauce. – [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q732)

## Good to know
- Both outbound flights require a self‑transfer at Barcelona; allow extra time.
- No checked baggage is included; only a personal item.
- São Bento Train Station is free and open all day.
- Museu Nacional Soares dos Reis is closed on 1 Jan, 1 May and 1 Dec.
- Some restaurants (e.g., O Comercial, Antiqvvm) require reservation.
- Prices shown are live at the time of planning; city taxes may be added at checkout.
